Join us for a curated lineup of designers, artists, and brands you won’t find anywhere else!

About this Event

El Souq: Holiday Edition Pop-Up
We're heading back to Manhattan
873 Broadway, New York, NY 
Join us on December 13 at 873 Broadway for El Souq’s Holiday Edition- a celebration of the creative intersections of SWANA, South Asia, and New York through fashion, food, and design.
Discover independent brands, meet the people behind them, and find something that speaks to you. From gifts for the people you love to pieces you’ll want to keep, explore a thoughtfully curated marketplace that brings culture, creativity, and community together.
Different cultures. One extraordinary space.

What to expect:40+ curated vendors across fashion, jewelry, home, art, and moreStreet food and small-batch baked goods inspired by diasporic flavorsHeadlining DJ to be announcedEl Souq is known for showcasing brands that honor their ancestral roots - through textiles, craft, and storytelling that span SWANA and South Asian cultures. Every pop-up is designed as both a marketplace and a gathering space - rooted in creativity, heritage, and connection.
Event Details
📍 Location: 873 Broadway, 2nd Floor
📅 Date: Sunday December 13, 2026
⏰ Time: 11:00 AM – 6:00 PM
About El Souq
El Souq is New York City’s first and only pop-up shopping concept dedicated to celebrating independent brands, creatives, and craftmakers from the SWANA (South West Asia and North Africa) and South Asian regions.
